summary: Full E2E validation of the new native AI Agent Framework (backend admin API + frontend Operations Console panel at /admin/ai-agents). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass covering auth guards, overview, agents CRUD w/ versioning, agent execution+memory recall (Emergent LLM), prompt render, tools list, workflow validation, workflow E2E with parallel+condition+HITL approve AND reject paths, policy get/update, audit trail, and regression on /api/email-notifications/templates/audit. Frontend: /admin/ai-agents renders with all 5 stat cards (Agents=10, Workflows=1, Executions=7, Pending=0, Tools=3), 4 tabs, 10 agent cards. Career Coach live LLM execution returned a real 387-char tip in ~10s via the UI. Executions (7), workflows (1), tools (3) render on their tabs. Mobile viewport (390px) renders correctly with responsive stat wrap. Zero regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Workflow step schema uses 'tool_name' + 'args' (NOT 'tool' + 'params') — recommend documenting in the routes/agent_framework.py docstring or a JSON schema so future integrators do not misconfigure workflows (I initially mis-authored the E2E test with 'tool'/'params' and the engine silently failed with 'Unknown tool ''' error). Consider adding a validate_workflow_steps() check that raises 400 when a step of type=tool has no non-empty tool_name.
agent-framework/executions list is currently unpaginated beyond a 200-cap limit; if executions grow > few hundred, admin UI should add pagination or a status filter shortcut.
The seeded workflow 'E2E Release Note Workflow' is the only Workflows-tab card at present — consider adding a couple more starter templates in the seeder to help admins learn the DSL.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all panel checks + live LLM run + mobile)

seed_data_creation: None persisted — TestAgentCrud creates 'test_qa_agent_<uuid>' and deletes it in the same test; TestWorkflowE2E creates a workflow via fixture and deletes it in teardown. Two ephemeral executions (approve + reject) remain in audit/execution history from the E2E workflow run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_agent_framework_admin_api.py is the durable regression suite for this feature. To re-run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_agent_framework_admin_api.py -v`. The suite includes an LLM-backed test (test_career_coach_execute_with_memory) that consumes Emergent LLM budget — expect ~25s total. Frontend panel testIDs render as data-testid attributes in DOM: use 'ai-agents-panel', 'agent-run-toggle-<key>', 'agent-run-input-<key>', 'agent-run-submit-<key>', 'agent-run-output-<key>', 'hitl-approve-<execution_id>', 'ai-agents-tab-<tab>'. Frontend is a STATIC EXPORT — do not attempt hot-reload edits.
rca_of_workflow_test_initial_failure: Initial workflow E2E test used step keys 'tool' and 'params' — the engine reads 'tool_name' and 'args' (engine.py lines 133/139). This caused parallel branch steps to fail with "Unknown tool ''" and the execution transitioned to 'failed' instead of pausing at human_approval. Fixed by renaming keys in WF_STEPS; both approve and reject E2E paths now pass. This is a test-authoring mistake, NOT a product bug, but the code review comment suggests hardening the validator to catch it earlier.
